prodinfo.prodname: X-Author Contracts for Cloud on Salesforce Summer 2019 User Guide

conbody.p: Update from CLM is an action button located in the X-Author Contracts for Cloud pane and you can use it to update smart fields and Readonly fields in your agreement document where fields have been updated in Apttus Contract Management since the document was generated. Update from CLM updates all header, 2nd, and 3rd level smart fields located in your document, including:

ul.li: Smart fields in the body of the agreement document.
Smart fields in tables or repeating datasets. Adding a new line item in Apttus Contract Management and updating will create a new row in the table.
If you choose to update fields from Apttus CLM, all changed smart field values and Readonly field values will be updated. You cannot select only specific fields.
Adding new line items to an Apttus CLM record and updating will only add a new row to the agreement document if a table exists containing those fields.
Fields cannot be updated to or from an empty (null) value.
